(ns build
  (:require [clojure.tools.build.api :as b]))

(def class-dir "target/classes")
(def uber-file "target/kvhttp.jar")
(def basis (delay (b/create-basis {:project "deps.edn"})))

(defn clean [_]
  (b/delete {:path "target"}))

(defn uber [_]
  (clean nil)
  (b/compile-clj {:basis @basis
                  :ns-compile '[kvhttp.main]
                  :class-dir class-dir
                  :compile-opts {:direct-linking true
                                 :elide-meta [:doc :file :line :added]}})
  (b/uber {:class-dir class-dir
           :uber-file uber-file
           :basis @basis
           :main 'kvhttp.main}))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an AOT-compiled uberjar and a ./app launcher for it.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

clojure -T:build uber

cat > app <<'LAUNCHER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
exec java -XX:+UseSerialGC -Xss1m -jar "$DIR/target/kvhttp.jar" "$@"
LAUNCHER
chmod +x app

(ns kvhttp.handler
  "Ring handler implementing the kvhttp routes."
  (:require [clojure.data.json :as json]
            [kvhttp.store :as store])
  (:import (java.io InputStream)))

(def ^:private key-pattern #"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}")

(def ^:private empty-body (byte-array 0))

(defn- response
  ([status] (response status empty-body))
  ([status body] {:status status :headers {} :body body}))

(defn- text [status ^String s]
  (-> (response status (.getBytes s "UTF-8"))
      (assoc-in [:headers "Content-Type"] "text/plain; charset=utf-8")))

(defn- method-not-allowed [allowed]
  (-> (response 405)
      (assoc-in [:headers "Allow"] allowed)))

(defn- read-body ^bytes [body]
  (cond
    (nil? body) empty-body
    (instance? InputStream body) (.readAllBytes ^InputStream body)
    (bytes? body) body
    :else (.getBytes (str body) "UTF-8")))

(defn- health [{:keys [request-method]}]
  (if (= :get request-method)
    (text 200 "ok")
    (method-not-allowed "GET")))

(defn- list-keys [db {:keys [request-method]}]
  (if (= :get request-method)
    (-> (response 200 (.getBytes ^String (json/write-str (store/list-keys db)) "UTF-8"))
        (assoc-in [:headers "Content-Type"] "application/json"))
    (method-not-allowed "GET")))

(defn- item [db k {:keys [request-method body]}]
  (cond
    (not (re-matches key-pattern k)) (response 400)

    (= :get request-method)
    (if-some [v (store/lookup db k)]
      (-> (response 200 v)
          (assoc-in [:headers "Content-Type"] "application/octet-stream"))
      (response 404))

    (= :put request-method)
    (response (if (store/put! db k (read-body body)) 201 200))

    (= :delete request-method)
    (response (if (store/delete! db k) 204 404))

    :else (method-not-allowed "GET, PUT, DELETE")))

(defn make-handler
  "Returns a Ring handler backed by the store `db`."
  [db]
  (fn [{:keys [uri] :as req}]
    (cond
      (= uri "/health") (health req)
      (= uri "/kv") (list-keys db req)
      (.startsWith ^String uri "/kv/") (item db (subs uri 4) req)
      :else (response 404))))

(ns kvhttp.main
  "Entry point: `app <port>` serves the key-value API on 127.0.0.1."
  (:require [kvhttp.handler :as handler]
            [kvhttp.store :as store]
            [org.httpkit.server :as http])
  (:gen-class))

(def ^:private max-body
  "Largest accepted request body: 1 MiB values plus generous headroom."
  (* 8 1024 1024))

(defn- parse-port [s]
  (when-let [n (some-> s parse-long)]
    (when (<= 1 n 65535) n)))

(defn -main [& args]
  (if-let [port (parse-port (first args))]
    (do
      (http/run-server (handler/make-handler (store/create))
                       {:ip "127.0.0.1"
                        :port port
                        :thread (max 8 (.availableProcessors (Runtime/getRuntime)))
                        :max-body max-body
                        :legacy-return-value? false})
      (println (str "kvhttp listening on 127.0.0.1:" port)))
    (binding [*out* *err*]
      (println "usage: app <port>")
      (System/exit 2))))

(ns kvhttp.store
  "In-memory key-value store. Keys are kept sorted so listing is cheap.")

(defn create
  "Returns a new, empty store."
  []
  (atom (sorted-map)))

(defn put!
  "Stores `value` under `k`. Returns true if the key was new."
  [store k value]
  (let [[old _] (swap-vals! store assoc k value)]
    (not (contains? old k))))

(defn lookup
  "Returns the value stored under `k`, or nil."
  [store k]
  (get @store k))

(defn delete!
  "Removes `k`. Returns true if it was present."
  [store k]
  (let [[old _] (swap-vals! store dissoc k)]
    (contains? old k)))

(defn list-keys
  "Returns every key in ascending order."
  [store]
  (vec (keys @store)))

(ns kvhttp.handler-test
  (:require [clojure.test :refer [deftest is testing]]
            [kvhttp.handler :as handler]
            [kvhttp.store :as store])
  (:import (java.io ByteArrayInputStream)))

(defn- request
  ([handler method uri] (request handler method uri nil))
  ([handler method uri ^String body]
   (handler {:request-method method
             :uri uri
             :body (some-> body (.getBytes "UTF-8") ByteArrayInputStream.)})))

(defn- body-str [resp] (String. ^bytes (:body resp) "UTF-8"))

(deftest crud
  (let [h (handler/make-handler (store/create))]
    (is (= 201 (:status (request h :put "/kv/a" "hello"))))
    (is (= "hello" (body-str (request h :get "/kv/a"))))
    (is (= 200 (:status (request h :put "/kv/a" "world"))))
    (is (= "world" (body-str (request h :get "/kv/a"))))
    (is (= 204 (:status (request h :delete "/kv/a"))))
    (is (= 404 (:status (request h :get "/kv/a"))))
    (is (= 404 (:status (request h :delete "/kv/a"))))))

(deftest listing
  (let [h (handler/make-handler (store/create))]
    (doseq [k ["b" "a" "c"]] (request h :put (str "/kv/" k) k))
    (let [resp (request h :get "/kv")]
      (is (= 200 (:status resp)))
      (is (= "application/json" (get-in resp [:headers "Content-Type"])))
      (is (= "[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\"]" (body-str resp))))))

(deftest errors
  (let [h (handler/make-handler (store/create))]
    (testing "invalid keys"
      (doseq [uri ["/kv/" "/kv/a/b" "/kv/bad.key" (str "/kv/" (apply str (repeat 65 "a")))]]
        (is (= 400 (:status (request h :get uri))) uri)))
    (testing "unknown paths"
      (doseq [uri ["/" "/nope" "/health/" "/kvx"]]
        (is (= 404 (:status (request h :get uri))) uri)))
    (testing "unsupported methods"
      (is (= 405 (:status (request h :post "/health"))))
      (is (= 405 (:status (request h :put "/kv"))))
      (is (= 405 (:status (request h :patch "/kv/a")))))))
